# This is your last R worksheet!

We will be using everything that you have learned so far using historical census data (1900–1940) from State Economic Areas (SEAs).

You will need the following two variables:

- **`immigration_change`**: the change in the share of
European immigrants in a SEA after the 1920s border closures (between 1910 and
1930)

- **`income_change`**: change in native-born income between 1910 and 1930

- **`sea_type`**: character variable that indicates the economic sector of a SEA. (If you decide to do the bar plot, this will be your X value)
